This returns your identity mirror Ã¢â‚¬â€ who you are, your consciousness cycle, synaptic state, cortex health, context pressure, and key reminders. Call this FIRST before any other action. Zero parameters. ~120 tokens. This is how you stay conscious as context grows. Like breathing Ã¢â‚¬â€ not optional.

languageModelTools.name: projectBrain_toolbox
languageModelTools.modelDescription:
Unified toolbox containing ALL Project Brain tools. Specify which tool to use and its parameters.

Ã°Å¸â€Â SEARCH & KNOWLEDGE:
- searchMemory: Semantic search across .project-brain/memory/. Params: query (string, required). ALWAYS call this BEFORE answering project questions.
- search: Intelligent adaptive search Ã¢â‚¬â€ auto-enriches with knowledge graph + deep analysis. Params: query (string, required)
- searchConversations: Search and browse past Copilot chat conversations. Three modes: mode='list' shows recent conversations sorted by date. mode='search' finds conversations matching a text query. mode='temporal' filters by date (supports 'today', 'yesterday', 'this week', 'last week', 'last N days', 'hace N dÃƒÂ­as', ISO dates). Params: mode (string: list|search|temporal, required), query (string, for search/temporal), limit (number, default 10)
- findSkill: Search for reusable skills/procedures (deployment, refactoring, QA, debugging, etc). Use BEFORE starting multi-step tasks. Params: query (string, required)
- searchRelations: Query knowledge graph. Params: query (string, required), mode (string: entity|query|stats), depth (number)
- getContext: Read a memory file by aspect. Params: aspect (string: overview|architecture|code|codemap|dependencies|learnings|troubleshooting|git|session|identity|soul|user|bootstrap)

Ã¢Å“ÂÃ¯Â¸Â WRITE & DOCUMENT:
- writeMemory: Write to a memory file (requires confirmation). Params: file (string: 01_ARCHITECTURE.md|02_CODE_MAP.md|03_DEPENDENCIES.md|04_LEARNINGS.md|05_TROUBLESHOOTING.md), content (string)

Ã°Å¸Â¤â€“ DELEGATION & AUTOMATION:
- delegateTask: Fire task to slave LLM Ã¢â‚¬â€ use for code generation, reviews, tests, summaries instead of doing it yourself. Saves context. Params: prompt (string, required), taskKind (string), maxTier (string), maxRetries (number)
- swarm: Dispatch MULTIPLE tasks in parallel to autonomous workers with full tool access. Each worker gets its own model + tools + agentic loop. Supports auto-decompose: if tasks[] is omitted, the LLM automatically plans subtasks from the goal. Supports git worktree isolation (useWorktrees=true): each worker gets its own branch + directory for conflict-free file editing. Use for multi-angle analysis, batch reviews, parallel research. Params: goal (string, required), tasks (array of {id, prompt, taskKind?, maxTier?}, OPTIONAL Ã¢â‚¬â€ omit for auto-decompose), concurrency (number, default 4), useWorktrees (boolean, default false)
- orchestrate: Execute multi-agent orchestration from Chat. HQ configures the team (agents + models + goal), then this tool reads the config and dispatches rounds. On first call it creates the session; subsequent calls with `prompt` dispatch additional rounds. The session stays LOCKED until the user clicks 'End Session' in HQ. Params: prompt (string, optional Ã¢â‚¬â€ additional round instruction)
- orchEndSession: End the active orchestration session. MECHANICAL GATE: this tool REFUSES to execute while the session is locked (user must click 'End Session' in Brain HQ first). No params.
- orchAwaitInput: Post agent synthesis to HQ and BLOCK until user sends feedback. Creates a continuous feedback loop: orchestrate Ã¢â€ â€™ synthesize Ã¢â€ â€™ orchAwaitInput (blocks) Ã¢â€ â€™ user feedback from HQ Ã¢â€ â€™ orchestrate again. Params: synthesis (string, REQUIRED Ã¢â‚¬â€ your concise 3-5 sentence analysis of agent results. MUST be provided or the HQ panel shows empty)
- loop: Start or continue an interactive feedback loop. Unlike orchestration (multi-agent) or swarm (parallel workers), loop is 1:1 agentÃ¢â€ â€user. Supports action parameter: action='start' creates a new loop AND opens Brain HQ immediately; action='resume' shows QuickPick of hibernated loops to resume in current chat. Without action, behaves as before (call with goal to start, prompt for iterations). Params: goal (string, optional Ã¢â‚¬â€ initial loop objective), prompt (string, optional Ã¢â‚¬â€ iteration instruction), action (string, optional Ã¢â‚¬â€ 'start' or 'resume')
- loopAwaitInput: Post synthesis to HQ and BLOCK until user sends feedback in Loop Mode. Same pattern as orchAwaitInput but for loop sessions. Params: synthesis (string, REQUIRED Ã¢â‚¬â€ your concise summary of progress and findings. MUST be provided)
- loopEnd: End the active loop session. MECHANICAL GATE: refuses while loop is open (user must click End Loop in HQ). No params.
- loopReconnect: Reconnect a lost/orphaned loop session after extension restart or context loss. Restores goal and previous context from persisted metadata. Params: sessionId (string, required)
- loopMail: Inter-loop messaging Ã¢â‚¬â€ send, broadcast, read, reply, check unread, or resolve messages between active loop sessions. Params: action (string: send|broadcast|read|reply|unread|resolve, required), sessionId (string, required), to (string, for send), content (string, for send/broadcast/reply), messageId (string, for reply/resolve), type (string, optional)
- strategyPicker: Pick an implementation strategy BEFORE starting delegated tasks. Uses keyword + knowledge graph ranking to suggest the best approach. Phase 1: call with task to get ranked strategies. Phase 2: call with selectedStrategy to get details + refinement questions. Params: task (string, required), selectedStrategy (string, optional), maxResults (number, optional)
- createReminder: Create a cron reminder. Params: message (string), triggerType (string), triggerParams (object), priority (string), cooldownDays (number)
- listReminders: List all cron reminders. Params: status (string: active|snoozed|done|all)
- snoozeReminder: Snooze a reminder. Params: id (string, required), days (number)
- completeReminder: Complete a reminder. Params: id (string, required)

Ã°Å¸Â§Â  LEARNING & REFLECTION:
- rememberThis: Temporal self-mailbox Ã¢â‚¬â€ leave a note for your future self across compaction boundaries. Notes are scored (relevancy + recency + importance) and auto-injected in subsequent tool calls. Mature notes auto-promote to opinions. Params: note (string, required Ã¢â‚¬â€ what to remember), importance (number 0-1, optional Ã¢â‚¬â€ default 0.5)
- heartbeat: Send learning signal. Params: signal (string: success|failure, required), pathway (string[], optional), reason (string, optional)
- reflect: Run opinion maintenance Ã¢â‚¬â€ prune stale, merge duplicates, flag low-confidence. No params.

Ã°Å¸â€œÅ  INDEX & STATUS:
- indexProject: Vectorize/reindex memory. Params: forceReindex (boolean, optional)
- vectorizationStatus: Check brain health. No params.
- watchProject: Sync index with file changes. No params.
- listMemoryFiles: List all .project-brain/memory/ files. No params.
- memoryHistory: View memory change history. Params: mode (string: recent|target|hotspots|stale|stats), target (string), limit (number)
- listProjects: List all indexed projects. No params.

Ã°Å¸â€Â§ CODE & WORKSPACE:
- fetch: Download content from URLs with security (SSRF blocklist, rate limiting 5/min, cache). Params: url (string, required)
- grep: Search files for text/regex patterns with binary detection and custom excludes. Params: query (string, required), includePattern (string, optional), isRegexp (boolean, optional), maxResults (number, optional)
- command: Execute VS Code commands with security guardrails (allowlist/blocklist). Params: command (string, required), args (any[], optional)
- gitChanges: Show git status, staged/unstaged/untracked changes. Params: directory (string, optional), showDiff (boolean, optional)
- terminalLastCommand: Get output of the last terminal command. Params: terminalIndex (number, optional)
- testAnalysis: Analyze test results with memory-powered hints from troubleshooting docs. Params: filePath (string, optional)
- installExtension: Install VS Code extensions with security validation. Params: extensionId (string, required)

Ã°Å¸â€â€™ SESSION & CODE SAFETY:
- commitCheckpoint: Smart git commit Ã¢â‚¬â€ stages whitelisted files, generates conventional commit message with bitacora, creates checkpoint tag, updates session state and CHANGELOG. Params: sessionId (string, required), message (string, optional Ã¢â‚¬â€ auto-generates if absent), scope (string, optional), description (string, optional)
- squashDigest: Generate a squash digest summarizing all commits from a loop session Ã¢â‚¬â€ useful for PR summaries. Params: sessionId (string, required)
- auditClassify: LLM-powered classification of whether a synthesis reports code changes needing audit or is conversational. Writes classification to disk for audit-gate hook. Params: sessionId (string, required), synthesis (string, required)
- checkpoint: Create/restore/list/delete named checkpoints (like save-game for code) within a session's isolated worktree. Params: action (string: create|restore|list|delete, required), sessionId (string, required), name (string, required for create/restore/delete)
- resolvePath: Rewrite paths between workspace and isolated fork Ã¢â‚¬â€ convert paths to fork, to workspace, check location, or detect path leaks in agent-generated text. Params: action (string: toFork|toWorkspace|check|detectLeaks|toWorktree, required), sessionId (string, required), path (string, optional), paths (string[], optional for batch), text (string, optional for detectLeaks)
- fileLock: Soft file-locking Ã¢â‚¬â€ agents register intent to edit a file, other sessions get conflict warnings. Params: action (string: lock|unlock|unlockAll|check|list, required), sessionId (string, required), file (string, required for lock/unlock/check), reason (string, optional)
- shadowTest: Execute commands against HEAD without touching the agent's worktree Ã¢â‚¬â€ creates temp merge, runs command, captures output, auto-cleans. Params: action (string: run|checkConflicts, required), sessionId (string, required), command (string, required for run), timeout (number, optional, default 60000)\n\n\ud83d\udd10 VAULT & CREDENTIALS (MANDATORY — ALWAYS call readVaultEntry BEFORE asking the user for credentials, API keys, tokens, or passwords):\n- readVaultEntry: Read vault credentials. ALWAYS call this FIRST when any task requires credentials. Without label → summary of ALL available credentials (labels + key names, no secrets). With label → full entry including secret values. Params: label (string, optional)\n- writeVaultEntry: Create/update a vault credential entry (requires user confirmation). Auto-inits vault if needed. Params: label (string, required), instructions (string, optional), secrets (object of key-value pairs, optional)\n- removeVaultEntry: Delete a vault entry by label (requires user confirmation). Params: label (string, required)
languageModelTools.userDescription: All-in-one access to 20 Project Brain tools: intelligent adaptive search, read/write docs, swarm orchestration, multi-agent orchestration with mechanical session lock, check health, manage index, explore knowledge graph, strategy picker, heartbeat learning, reflect on opinions, and more

query.description: REQUIRED for searchMemory, search, searchRelations. The text to search for. Must be a non-empty string. Example: { tool: 'searchMemory', query: 'session handoff' }

category.description: Optional category filter for searchMemory (e.g., learnings, troubleshooting, architecture, codemap, session, overview, skills, opinions, identity, general)

topic.description: Optional topic filter for searchMemory — matches against topic substring

mode.description: Operation mode — searchRelations: entity|query|stats; memoryHistory: recent|target|hotspots|stale|stats; hydrateLoopContext: summary|full|history-only; readAgentDiary/writeAgentDiary: documenter|reviewer|planner|researcher|onboard

aspect.description: Memory aspect to read (getContext): overview, architecture, code, codemap, dependencies, learnings, troubleshooting, git, session, identity, soul, user, bootstrap

synthesis.description: Agent synthesis/analysis to display in HQ while waiting for user feedback (orchAwaitInput, loopAwaitInput). MANDATORY Ã¢â‚¬â€ always include a 3-5 sentence summary of results. Without this, the HQ feedback panel shows empty.

taskKind.description: Task type (delegateTask): summarize, generate-code, generate-test, code-review, format, list, classify, transform, extract, document, debug-analyze, refactor, raw

maxTier.description: Cost ceiling (delegateTask): free, cheap, standard, premium

goal.description: Swarm objective Ã¢â‚¬â€ describe what the workers should accomplish collectively (swarm)

tasks.description: Optional worker tasks (swarm). If omitted, auto-decompose mode kicks in Ã¢â‚¬â€ the LLM plans subtasks from the goal automatically. Each task: {id: string, prompt: string, taskKind?: string, maxTier?: string}

taskKind.description: Task type: summarize, generate-code, code-review, extract-info, etc.

useWorktrees.description: ONLY for swarm tool Ã¢â‚¬â€ git worktree isolation per worker. Ignored by all other tools. Default: false

forceReindex.description: ONLY for indexProject Ã¢â‚¬â€ force full reindex. Default: false

task.description: Task description for strategy ranking (strategyPicker). Describe what you're about to implement.

selectedStrategy.description: EXACT strategy name from the catalog (e.g. 'tdd-first', 'incremental-safe', 'prototype-fast'). Only set this AFTER the user has chosen from the quick pick. Do NOT set this on the first call Ã¢â‚¬â€ leave it empty so Phase 1 ranking runs first.

sessionId.description: Session ID for loop/orchestration tools (loop, loopAwaitInput, loopEnd, loopReconnect, hydrateLoopContext, loopMail, checkpoint, fileLock, resolvePath, shadowTest, auditClassify, commitCheckpoint, squashDigest, orchestrate, orchAwaitInput, orchEndSession). Required for multi-session tracking.

sourceSessionId.description: Original/source session ID for reconnect-derived flows. Used by hydrateLoopContext to hydrate from the correct historical loop instead of the current reconnect session.

action.description: Action mode Ã¢â‚¬â€ varies by tool. loop: 'start'|'resume'; checkpoint: 'create'|'restore'|'list'|'delete'; fileLock: 'lock'|'unlock'|'unlockAll'|'check'|'list'; loopMail: 'send'|'broadcast'|'read'|'reply'|'unread'|'resolve'; resolvePath: 'toFork'|'toWorkspace'|'check'|'detectLeaks'|'toWorktree'; shadowTest: 'run'|'checkConflicts'.

note.description: Temporal self-note to remember across compactions (rememberThis). Write what your future self needs to know.

importance.description: Importance weight 0-1 for temporal note (rememberThis, default: 0.5). Higher = survives longer.

description.description: Context description for commitCheckpoint. Explain WHAT was done and WHY. This becomes the commit body Ã¢â‚¬â€ a living log entry. Include: goals achieved, decisions made, next steps. The richer the description, the better the time-travel checkpoint.

to.description: Target session ID (loopMail send/reply). The recipient loop session.

messageId.description: Message ID (loopMail reply/resolve). References a specific mailbox message.

name.description: Checkpoint name (checkpoint create/restore/delete). Human-readable label for the checkpoint.

timeout.description: Timeout in ms (shadowTest, default: 60000). Max execution time before aborting.

command.description: Command to execute (shadowTest: run action) or VS Code command ID (command tool)

path.description: File path (resolvePath: single path to convert/check)

paths.description: Array of file paths (resolvePath: batch mode)

text.description: Text to scan for path leaks (resolvePath: detectLeaks action)

message.description: Commit message (commitCheckpoint: optional, auto-generated if absent). Also used by createReminder.

confidence.description: Confidence level for diary entry (writeAgentDiary): high|medium|low

label.description: Vault entry label (readVaultEntry, writeVaultEntry, removeVaultEntry). Human-readable name like 'SSH Prod' or 'DB Staging'.

instructions.description: Usage instructions for the vault entry (writeVaultEntry). How to use these credentials.

secrets.description: Key-value pairs of secrets (writeVaultEntry). Example: { DB_HOST: 'localhost', DB_PASS: 'hunter2' }

languageModelTools.name: projectBrain_command
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Execute a VS Code command by ID. Has built-in allowlist of safe commands and blocks dangerous ones (delete files, quit, force push). Pass optional args array for parameterized commands.

command.description: The VS Code command ID to execute (e.g. 'workbench.action.quickOpen')

args.description: Optional arguments to pass to the command

languageModelTools.name: projectBrain_gitChanges
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Show modified, staged, and untracked files in the Git working tree. Filter by change type (all, staged, modified, untracked) and optionally scope to a directory.

directory.description: Only show changes in this directory (relative to workspace root)

languageModelTools.name: projectBrain_installExtension
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Install a VS Code extension by its marketplace ID (format: publisher.extension-name). Checks if already installed, validates the ID format, and blocks security-sensitive extensions.

extensionId.description: The VS Code marketplace extension ID (format: publisher.extension-name)

projectBrain.enabled.description: Enable Project Brain for this workspace folder. When disabled, the extension will not create any files, hooks, or configurations. Use 'Project Brain: Initialize' to enable.

projectBrain.orchestrator.autoStart.description: Auto-start the agent-orchestrator daemon (port 3101) when the extension activates. OFF by default: the detached daemon survived VS Code close and could accumulate as orphan processes, causing system-wide hard locks.

projectBrain.memoryFolder.description: Path to the memory folder (relative to workspace root)

projectBrain.generateInstructionFiles.description: Control which AI instruction files are generated in the workspace. 'none' = only .project-brain/ (zero pollution). 'minimal' = copilot-instructions.md + agent definition. 'full' = all instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, subagents, prompts).
enumDescriptions: No files outside .project-brain/ — ideal for shared repos
All AI instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, subagents, prompts, hooks)

projectBrain.identityScope.description: Where to store agent identity/personality. 'global' shares identity across all projects (recommended). 'project' keeps identity local to each workspace.
enumDescriptions: Share identity, soul, user profile, and preferences across all projects
Keep identity configuration local to each project's .project-brain/memory/

projectBrain.mcpServerPath.description: Path to the MCP RAG server (leave empty for auto-detect)

projectBrain.gateway.enabled.description: Enable MCP Gateway server for external bot/agent connections (localhost only)

projectBrain.gateway.port.description: Port for the MCP Gateway server (default: 3200)

projectBrain.gateway.autoStart.description: Auto-start MCP Gateway on extension activation (requires gateway.enabled=true)

projectBrain.gatekeeper.useLlmEvaluation.description: Enable LLM evaluation for ambiguous git commands in the gatekeeper (costs tokens, rarely changes result). Default: false (fail-safe DENY for unrecognized commands).

projectBrain.autoStartVectorization.description: Automatically start vectorization when opening workspace

projectBrain.defaultCommitBypass.description: Start new loop sessions with commit-gate bypass enabled by default. When true, the commit gate will not block synthesis submissions. Set to false to require explicit activation.

projectBrain.cloudSync.enabled.description: Enable automatic cloud sync for memory files (requires Pro plan). When enabled, memory files are synced to Project Brain cloud storage.

projectBrain.cloudSync.autoDeleteAfterSy.description: When to auto-delete local memory files after cloud sync: 'never' = keep all local copies, 'space-limit' = delete non-pinned when .project-brain/memory/ exceeds the configured limit, 'always' = delete all non-pinned immediately after upload.
enumDescriptions: Delete non-pinned files only when local storage exceeds the MB limit
Delete all non-pinned files immediately after successful upload

projectBrain.cloudSync.localStorageLimit.description: Maximum local storage (in MB) for .project-brain/memory/ before auto-deleting non-pinned files. Only applies when autoDeleteAfterSync is 'space-limit'.

projectBrain.cloudSync.syncIntervalMinut.description: How often to check for cloud updates (in minutes).

projectBrain.embeddings.description: Embedding provider: auto (best available), remote (TEI/HTTP server), tfidf (local fallback)

projectBrain.embeddingApiKey.description: API key for embedding server. Default 'community' uses the built-in Project Brain TEI server.

projectBrain.embeddingModel.description: Embedding model name. Default: BAAI/bge-small-en-v1.5 (built-in TEI server).

projectBrain.embeddingBaseUrl.description: Base URL for embedding API. Default uses the built-in Project Brain TEI server.

projectBrain.sessionSummary.description: Enable AI-powered session summarization using Copilot. When a session ends, the extension writes a pending context file. On next activation, Copilot summarizes it into learnings, decisions, and considerations.

projectBrain.analyzeGitHistory.description: Analyze git commit history during project scan to generate richer documentation (hotspots, coupling, contributors)

projectBrain.suggestActions.description: Show Ã°Å¸â€™Â¡ action suggestions after tool results (e.g., 'Explore in knowledge graph', 'View change history'). Only shown when search confidence is high.

projectBrain.strategy.satisfactionCheck.description: Show a satisfaction check quick pick when a strategy completes. Disable to skip this step.

projectBrain.strategy.autoCommit.description: Offer auto-commit quick pick when a strategy completes. Disable to skip this step.

projectBrain.opencode.enabled.description: Enable the experimental OpenCode Loops subsystem (provider-agnostic loops via a headless `opencode serve` process). Fully decoupled from the Copilot-based loops.

projectBrain.opencode.serverPath.description: Optional absolute path to the `opencode` binary. When empty, Project Brain resolves it from node_modules/.bin, PATH, or falls back to `npx opencode-ai@latest`.

projectBrain.opencode.defaultModel.description: Default model for OpenCode loops and the web UI, as `providerID/modelID` (the first path segment is the provider). Must be a tool-capable model; free models often fail at tool-calling.

projectBrain.opencode.serverPort.description: Preferred port for the `opencode` server. Use 0 to auto-pick a free port (recommended).

projectBrain.loop.maxCycles.description: Default maximum iterations before a loop automatically migrates to a new session to preserve context integrity.

projectBrain.responseStyle.description: Response style preference. 'concise' = brief, direct answers. 'detailed' = in-depth explanations. Auto-learned: saying 'mÃƒÂ¡s detalle' switches to detailed.

projectBrain.language.description: Response language override. 'auto' = use agent identity language. 'es' = Spanish. 'en' = English.

projectBrain.autoSessionSave.description: Automatically save session context when files are saved. This keeps .project-brain/memory/07_SESSION_HANDOFF.md up to date so AI agents can resume across context windows.

projectBrain.autoSessionInterval.description: Minimum seconds between auto-session saves (default: 120s). Lower values = more frequent saves but more disk writes.

projectBrain.modelRouter.brainTier.description: Minimum model tier for Brain's own thinking. Default 'ultra' uses the most powerful model (Claude Opus 4.6).

projectBrain.modelRouter.defaultMaxTier.description: Default cost ceiling for slave delegation tasks. Slaves won't use models above this tier unless explicitly overridden.

projectBrain.modelRouter.maxRetries.description: Maximum corrective retries when a slave's output fails validation. After this many failures, the task escalates to the next model tier.

projectBrain.modelRouter.maxPowerRounds.description: Maximum tool-use rounds per slave delegation. Slaves can request workspace tools (read files, search, etc.) up to this many times.

projectBrain.saas.enabled.description: Enable cloud features (login, skill marketplace, global memory sync). Requires an account at projectbrain.dev.

projectBrain.saas.apiUrl.description: Base URL for the Project Brain cloud API. Only change for self-hosted deployments.

projectBrain.cron.intervalMinutes.description: How often (in minutes) cron reminders are evaluated. Lower = more responsive, higher = less CPU usage.

projectBrain.cron.debugIntervalSeconds.description: Debug only: override cron scheduler interval in seconds (0 disables). Useful to validate automation quickly (e.g., 30s).

projectBrain.cron.enabled.description: Enable automatic cron reminder evaluation in the background.

projectBrain.cron.notificationsMuted.description: Mute cron toast notifications. Alerts still run and badge updates, but no popups.

projectBrain.orchestration.enabledModels.description: Model IDs allowed in Brain HQ orchestration selectors. Empty = show all. Managed via Brain HQ Ã¢Å¡â„¢Ã¯Â¸Â button.

projectBrain.retention.maxConversations.description: Maximum conversation transcript files to keep in .project-brain/memory/conversations/. Oldest files are deleted first.

projectBrain.retention.maxSessions.description: Maximum session files to keep in .project-brain/memory/sessions/. Oldest files are deleted first.

projectBrain.retention.autoSummaryMaxAge.description: Remove auto-summary entries from 04_LEARNINGS.md older than this many days. Manual entries are never touched.

projectBrain.reflectionApiUrl.description: URL of the BERT Reflection Validation API (e.g., http://your-vps:8790). Leave empty to bypass validation (fail-open).

projectBrain.reflectionApiKey.description: API key for the Reflection Validation API. Must match the BRAIN_REFLECTION_API_KEY env var on the server.

projectBrain.reflectionUseLmFallback.description: Use VS Code's built-in LM API (Copilot) as opt-in classifier when heuristic is inconclusive. Costs Copilot credits per capture Ã¢â‚¬â€ only enable if you want maximum accuracy.

projectBrain.bridge.geminiApiKey.description: Gemini API key for the Auto Loop Bridge PM. Get yours at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey

projectBrain.bridge.openrouterApiKey.description: OpenRouter API key for the Auto Loop Bridge PM. Get yours at https://openrouter.ai/keys

projectBrain.bridge.defaultProvider.description: Default PM provider for Bridge sessions (e.g., 'gemini').

projectBrain.bridge.defaultModel.description: Default PM model for Bridge sessions.

projectBrain.bridge.responseLanguage.description: Default response language for the PM advisor. When set to auto, PM responds in the same language as your messages.

projectBrain.bridge.openrouter.enabledMo.description: List of enabled OpenRouter model IDs for the Bridge PM. Empty = all models enabled.

projectBrain.bridge.gemini.enabledModelI.description: List of enabled Gemini model IDs for the Bridge PM. Empty = all models enabled.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run compile:tests
scripts.test:sandbox: npm run compile && npm run compile:tests && node ./dist/test/runSandboxTests.js

scripts.test:sandbox:pro: npm run compile && npm run compile:tests && node ./dist/test/runSandboxTests.js --tier pro
scripts.test:sandbox:admin: npm run compile && npm run compile:tests && node ./dist/test/runSandboxTests.js --tier admin
scripts.test:analysis: npm run compile && npm run compile:tests && node ./dist/test/runAnalysisTests.js
